explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/372: there are infinitely many n with P(n) > P(n+1) > P(n+2), P the largest prime factor (proved by Balog). The statement is that {n | maxPrimeFac n > maxPrimeFac (n+1) > maxPrimeFac (n+2)} is infinite. The conventions at 0 and 1 affect only finitely many n. Faithful.
